messages:
Maya (pmktg): Heads-up: Finalizing release announcement for Redwood Optimize v0.9 tomorrow 9am PT. Need final changelog link, docs anchor, webinar registration URL, and confirmation on canary rollout window. @Sam @Priya @Alex
Sam (eng): On it. Can we keep canary at 10am-11am PT with a 10% traffic ramp? infra says yes. Will confirm model-serving change in release notes.
Priya (docs): I'll publish docs PR now and post the stable docs URL here when merged. ETA 30m.
Alex (growth): For webinar CTAs, we'll use /webinar/optimize-launch?utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=optimize_v09 — can you add a 30-min preflight demo slot to the runbook, @Maya?
Maya (pmktg): Yes — preflight demo at 8:15am PT. Also need benchmark narrative blurb: short paragraph about 2x cost reduction for chat workloads. @Sam can you provide the single-sentence metric?
Sam (eng): Single-sentence metric: 'In our internal evals, Redwood Optimize reduces per-token cost by ~48% for 2k-context chat with adaptive batching.'
Priya (docs): Docs PR merged: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v0.9 — anchor is #what-changed. Changelog is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/compare/v0.8...v0.9
Sam (eng): Changelog diff snippet:
```
- fallback routing: legacy path
+ smart routing: region/cost fallback
```
No user-facing breaking changes.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview: staging.redwood.ai/optimize/preview-1733333333 (status: success) :rocket:
Alex (growth): We'll schedule email at T+15m after announce, using leads funnel tag 'optimize_v09_launch'. Who's owning the inbound routing for signups?
Maya (pmktg): @Alex I'll route to Growth and SDRs. @Priya can you add a hidden form field `utm_campaign=optimize_v09` on the reg form?
Priya (docs): Done. Form updated and validated. Sample payload: `utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=optimize_v09`
Sam (eng): One more ask: if canary shows >3xx errors we rollback to v0.8 auto. Ops alert added.
Maya (pmktg): Perfect — thanks team :thumbsup: I'll post the publish note at 9:00am PT and ping here once live.
